name: google-contacts
description: Bidirectional Google Contacts (People API) integration. Schedule trigger polls people.connections.list with the syncToken cursor (full re-list on 410 expiry); item-event trigger pushes Marfa google.contacts.contact / core.entity.person changes back via the OAuth proxy with etag-based optimistic concurrency. Reuses the Google OAuth provider credential established for the google.* family via credential_ref.
